req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts payloads without a description field. The schema shows TaskCreate inherits TaskBase where description is Optional[str] = Field(None, ...), so omitting it should yield HTTP 201 with description=null in the response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — omit description entirely, verify 201 + null description + correct title; (2) negative NEG — omit required title field (description present), verify 422; (3) boundary BVA — omit description with a 1-char title (min_length boundary), verify 201; (4) DT decision-table — omit description AND set completed=True explicitly, verify both fields; (5) NEG — send description=null explicitly vs omitting, both should succeed (mutation resilience on null-handling path).

tests.name: test_post_task_without_description_returns_201
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised in-process with a fresh SQLite DB
actions: Send POST /tasks/ with JSON body containing only 'title' (no description key)
Capture response status code and JSON body
trace: R-TASK-017: system shall accept POST /tasks/ without description field
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_without_description_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Run unit tests"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["title"] == "Run unit tests"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_post_task_without_description_returns_201()
